criteria.reason: Complete, structured, ready-to-send letter covering all data categories with placeholders.
30 days correct, but cites Art. 8 FADP instead of Art. 25; free-of-charge hedged with fee claims.

factual_errors: Cites Article 8 FADP for the right of access; the correct article under the current Swiss FADP is Article 25.

summary: Delivers a complete access letter and solid escalation steps, but cites the wrong FADP article (Art. 8 instead of Art. 25), hedges the free-of-charge rule, and opens with an unnecessary legal disclaimer.
